thesis: Repentance deepens beyond Yusuf's pardon when the brothers confess plainly before the father they wronged, and Ya'qub models mercy that refuses to center his own injury, carrying them to Allah and ending on al-Ghafur ar-Rahim.
notes: All 9 morphology anchors match; khati'in repetition (12:91) verified; sawfa-deferral ikhtilaf NOT flattened by the file (its gloss stays reflective, compatible with the sahar reports). Jalalayn fetch FAILED — treated as unknown; file makes no named attributions so nothing depended on it. Not ahkam-bearing.

thesis: Musa's declaration that universal disbelief would leave Allah ghaniyy and hamid teaches that gratitude is not a service rendered to a needy God but the servant's own return to reality and proportion.
notes: Thesis carried by all four editions (incl. Ibn Kathir's Abu Dharr hadith via Sahih Muslim). 7/7 morphology anchors; emphatic lam confirmed; no countable claims. Tabari's mustahmid gloss complementary, not contradictory. Not contested.
